fusions.name: Headsman's Measure
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: a chop that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nailed to the Spot
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that hits the first enemy in its path for 7 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Chalk Line
fusions.desc: Your critical hits deal 40% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Along the Grain
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
